scripts.dev:mac: npm run build && concurrently -k "wrangler dev --config wrangler.mac.toml --port 8787" "vite --host 0.0.0.0"
scripts.deploy:mac: npm run build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.mac.toml
scripts.db:migrate:mac: wrangler d1 migrations apply market-atlas-intelligence --config wrangler.mac.toml --remote
scripts.db:migrate:local:mac: wrangler d1 migrations apply market-atlas-intelligence --config wrangler.mac.toml --local
